manifest.title: robot arm
manifest.question: Can these hobby servos lift a 500 g payload through this desktop arm's pick and place?
manifest.headline: The shoulder servo stalls. Carrying 500 g through this move needs 1.35 N m (13.7 kg cm) almost at rest, where the TowerPro MG996R at 6 V gives 1.07 N m (11 kg cm). The hand hits the table at 0.241 s.
manifest.axes: z is up; quaternions are w, x, y, z and turn each shape from its own frame into the world
manifest.shapes: sizes follow MuJoCo: sphere [radius], capsule and cylinder [radius, half length] along their own z axis, box [half x, half y, half z], plane [half x, half y] at z = pos; a body marked bounds is a mesh drawn as the box that bounds it
manifest.source: recorded by the MuJoCo run itself at evenly spaced steps; series are interpolated from the run's samples at the same instants
